# data.docker_volumes

<!-- Code generated by tools/genskill from the provider schema. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Kind: data-source. Back to [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md).

Lists the volumes on the provider's Docker host (`GET /volumes`), like `docker volume ls`. The optional arguments are Engine API filters; `volumes.volumes` is sorted by name. The raw `volumes_json` output is sensitive because driver options can hold credentials.

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |

| `content_sha256` | `string` | computed |  |  | sha256 of volumes_json. |
| `dangling` | `bool` | optional |  |  | `true` lists only volumes no container uses, `false` only used ones. |
| `docker_server_version` | `string` | computed |  |  | Docker Engine version from GET /version. |
| `driver` | `string` | optional |  |  | Only volumes using this driver, e.g. `local`. |

| `labels` | `map(string)` | optional |  |  | Only volumes carrying every one of these labels (Engine `label` filter); an empty value matches any value. |
| `name` | `string` | optional |  |  | Only volumes whose name matches (Engine `name` filter, a substring match). |

## Example

```terraform
# Volumes no container uses.
data "docker_volumes" "unused" {
  dangling = true
}

output "unused_volume_names" {
  value = data.docker_volumes.unused.names
}
```
